t: A pocket sensor box with Bluetooth, Thread, and machine learning demos.
steps: Buy the Thingy:53 from DigiKey or Avnet for about 59 to 65 US dollars.
Charge it with a USB-C cable.
Install the nRF Edge Impulse app on your phone.
Pair the phone with the box and watch live sensor data.
Record some motion and train a first model in the app.
Install nRF Connect for VS Code on your computer to write your own code.
Build a Zephyr sample for the thingy53 board and update it over USB or the phone.
meta: Open Board. From $59. A few stores.
